newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: HI downgrades 1997 net forecast by 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: HI downgrades 1997 net forecast by 30 pct.

text.p: House of Investments Inc downgraded on Monday its 1997 net income forecast by 30 percent to 215 million pesos from an earlier estimate of 303.5 million.

Vice president Elsie Maglaya told an analysts' briefing the firm trimmed its projected net income this year due to weak first half earnings and prospects of higher interest payments from its dollar loans.
House of Investments reported a 31 percent drop in net income to 89.4 million pesos in the first six months of the year versus the year-ago 129.9 million.
"We have reduced our income forecast for 1997 as a result of our operations in the first half," Maglaya said.
Maglaya attributed the drop in the firm's profits to weak contributions from subsidiaries, primarily BA Savings Bank.
House of Investments, the investment arm of Filipino-Chinese businessman Alfonso Yuchengco, has interests in banking, real estate, agribusiness, construction and engineering.
